R1.condition: every start in T0_STARTS ends with |split_hat - split_true| <= 1e-4

R2.condition: sd(split_hat) within [0.7, 1.4] x CRB sd (iid), AND the bound-hit fraction within +/- 5 percentage points of the CRB-predicted fraction

R4.condition: report which of T2 / T3 lands at split = 0.99 (split_hat >= 0.99 - BOUND_TOL); outcome is one of 'T2 only', 'T3 only', 'both', 'neither'

definitions.bound_hit: split_hat >= ub - BOUND_TOL or split_hat <= lb + BOUND_TOL, BOUND_TOL = 1e-6
definitions.predicted_bound_hit: Gaussian approximation: P(N(split_true, sd^2) >= 0.99) + P(N(split_true, sd^2) <= 0.50); sd = iid CRB sd for T1, OLS sandwich sd under the AR(1) covariance for T1b
definitions.fires: a rule fires when its condition is true

method.question: is split's run to 0.99 a model unidentifiability or a pull from the real residual?

simulator.kind: exact modal LTI integration (not solve_ivp, not lsim)
simulator.description: A = V diag(lam) V^-1 (numpy.linalg.eig); per 1 s interval, z_j(k+1) = e^{lam_j} z_j(k) + beta_j * int_0^1 e^{lam_j(1-tau)} Q(t_k+tau) dtau; integral by composite Simpson on M+1 points of the true Q from calibrate.precompute_cycle's interpolants; recurrence via scipy.signal.lfilter; deviation coordinates from T_inf; IC T_core = T_surf = T_surf_meas[0]
simulator.why_not_lsim: first-order hold at 1 Hz is not exact for this Q (piecewise quadratic within each second); max |lsim FOH - simulate_T| on US06 was 0.113 K in the pre-run check, and lsim's loop is too slow for N = 200 tiers

G1_reference.gate: max |modal(M=16) - reference| <= 1e-06 K on every cycle
report_only: simulate_T at rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-12, max_step 5 vs reference (integration error of the standard tight setting)

method.G2: bitwise determinism: two fresh worker processes and the parent produce identical modal T_surf (full grid, 3 cycles), identical first iid and AR(1) noise draws, and an identical T1 replicate-0 primary fit

G3.gate: || dy/dsplit (rel) || within 0.001 of the 0.02 step's, central differences at truth, stride-10 stack

G4.gate: primary fit on the real data lands at 0.99 (>= 0.99 - 1e-06) and its cost is within 0.01 % of the reference

method.truth: locked central point, step4_central_fit (split, R_cs central; C_total, R_sa locked)
method.data: three calibration cycles at 25 degC, stride 10, real Q(t) and T_inf

fits.unspecified_choices: jac='3-point' and x_scale='jac' (as Part 1); max_nfev=1000; the joint T0 uses every T0 split start with R_cs start 1.5

noise.sigma: RMS of the real residual (modal model at truth minus measured T_surf), stride 10, three cycles

T1b.model: stationary AR(1) at 1 Hz per cycle, cycles independent, then [::10]
T1b.recursion: x_0 = sigma e_0; x_k = phi x_{k-1} + sigma sqrt(1 - phi^2) e_k

noise.T2: y = y_truth - offset, offset = per-cycle mean of the real residual
noise.T4: y = y_truth - r_real (= the measured data); must reproduce G4
noise.initial_condition: every synthetic fit uses the real T_surf_meas[0] as the IC (known input)

crb.jacobian: central differences at truth, rel step 0.001, stride-10 stack
crb.ar1_ols_sandwich: cov = (J^T J)^-1 J^T Sigma J (J^T J)^-1, Sigma = block-diag AR(1) at stride 10

a.inputs: Q(t) and T_amb(t) only; parameters constant; Q does not depend on the state
a.T_amb: constant T_inf (interp1d of a constant series, T_inf_override)
a.Q_interpolation: other: Q(t) = I(t) * (V(t) - V_ocv(SOC(t))), with I, V, SOC linear interp1d on the 1 Hz grid and V_ocv a linear interp1d of the OCV table; Q is piecewise quadratic within each second, with kinks at OCV-table nodes, so neither zero- nor first-order hold is exact

b.note: The T_inf channel is excited in the LG data only by the initial offset T0 - T_inf (T_inf constant); the zero-input response is (T0 - T_inf) (1 - G_T(s)) / s.

dc.meaning: coefficients divided by the denominator's constant term

monic.meaning: coefficients divided by the denominator's leading coefficient

real_residual.definition: r_real = modal T_surf at truth - measured T_surf, stride 10
